add_failed.body: Editing settings.toml failed. Close the desktop-widget editor and try again.
add_failed.title: Could not add the post-it

no_tool.body: tools/noctes-widget will not run, so nothing can put paper on the desktop. Notes still open, save and edit.
no_tool.title: Post-its need python3

unreadable.moved: It is kept, untouched, as {path}. Notes from now on save to a fresh notes.json.
unreadable.stuck: {path} could not be read or moved aside, so noctes will not save over it. Fix or move it, then reload.
unreadable.title: notes.json could not be read

panel.color_dynamic_classic: Dynamic: the paper is generated from this note's key. Turn on “Paper follows the theme” to make it track the wallpaper.
panel.color_dynamic_theme: Dynamic: the paper is generated from this note's key and follows the theme, so it recolors with the wallpaper.
panel.color_fixed: Fixed paper: stays this color whatever the theme does.
panel.color_glass: Glass: a translucent pane instead of paper, tinted by the shell's surface. Sharp, not blurred - a plugin gets no blur to work with.
panel.title: Noctes

color.description: Automatic derives a color from the key, and the note's own color wins when it has one.
color.label: Paper color

default_color.description: Colour new notes get. Automatic leaves it to the sheet's key.
default_color.label: Default color

fold.description: Off by default: a diagonal can only be drawn as a staircase here, and it shows.
fold.label: Folded corner

font_path.description: Bundled Patrick Hand by default. Give an absolute or ~ path for another .ttf/.otf, or empty for the shell font.
font_path.label: Font file

font_size.description: Body size. A handwriting font needs a couple of points more than a UI font.
font_size.label: Font size

key.description: Which note this post-it shows. Set the same key on a note in the panel.
key.label: Note key

opacity_override.description: 0 follows the plugin-wide opacity. The text stays fully opaque either way.
opacity_override.label: Paper opacity (this sheet)

paper_opacity_all.description: How solid every post-it is. The text stays fully opaque.
paper_opacity_all.label: Paper opacity

paper_size.description: Size of the paper itself, in px. Make the widget box a little larger.

save_path.description: Folder for notes.json. Empty uses the plugin's own data directory.
save_path.label: Save folder

shadow.description: Lifts the paper off the wallpaper
shadow.label: Drop shadow

show_count.label: Show note count in the bar

show_title.description: Draw the note title above the body
show_title.label: Show title

tape.description: Automatic decides from the key whether this post-it is taped, and where.
tape.label: Tape

theme_colors.description: Use the Noctalia palette instead of the classic paper colors. The palette tracks the wallpaper, so every post-it recolors with it.
theme_colors.label: Paper follows the theme

tilt.description: Sheets sit at a small random angle. Turning this off squares every one of them; turning it back on gives each a new angle.
tilt.label: Crooked sheets

use_theme_colors.description: Overrides the plugin-wide setting for this sheet only.
use_theme_colors.label: Paper follows the theme
